def AlgebraicGeometry.etalePrimeLiftOverHom.{u} : {k : Type u} →
  [inst : Field k] →
    (T : CategoryTheory.Over (AlgebraicGeometry.Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) →
      (U : ↑T.left.affineOpens) →
        (E : Algebra.EtaleCover ↑(T.left.presheaf.obj (Opposite.op ↑U))) →
          (S : PrimeSpectrum E.Carrier → Type u) →
            [inst_1 : (p : PrimeSpectrum E.Carrier) → CommRing (S p)] →
              [inst_2 : (p : PrimeSpectrum E.Carrier) → Algebra E.Carrier (S p)] →
                [inst_3 : (p : PrimeSpectrum E.Carrier) → Algebra k (S p)] →
                  [∀ (p : PrimeSpectrum E.Carrier), IsScalarTower k E.Carrier (S p)] →
                    (p : PrimeSpectrum E.Carrier) → AlgebraicGeometry.overSpec k (S p) ⟶ T :=
fun {k} [Field k] T U E S [(p : PrimeSpectrum E.Carrier) → CommRing (S p)]
    [(p : PrimeSpectrum E.Carrier) → Algebra E.Carrier (S p)] [(p : PrimeSpectrum E.Carrier) → Algebra k (S p)]
    [∀ (p : PrimeSpectrum E.Carrier), IsScalarTower k E.Carrier (S p)] p =>
  CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (AlgebraicGeometry.Over.overSpecMap (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k E.Carrier (S p)))
    (CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp
      (AlgebraicGeometry.Over.overSpecMap
        (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k (↑(T.left.presheaf.obj (Opposite.op ↑U))) E.Carrier))
      (AlgebraicGeometry.Over.fromSpecAffine T U))

def AlgebraicGeometry.etalePrimeLiftCover.{u} : {k : Type u} →
  [inst : Field k] →
    (T : CategoryTheory.Over (AlgebraicGeometry.Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) →
      (U : ↑T.left.affineOpens) →
        (E : Algebra.EtaleCover ↑(T.left.presheaf.obj (Opposite.op ↑U))) →
          (S : PrimeSpectrum E.Carrier → Type u) →
            [inst_1 : (p : PrimeSpectrum E.Carrier) → CommRing (S p)] →
              [inst_2 : (p : PrimeSpectrum E.Carrier) → Algebra E.Carrier (S p)] →
                [∀ (p : PrimeSpectrum E.Carrier), Algebra.Etale E.Carrier (S p)] →
                  ↑U = ⊤ →
                    (q : (p : PrimeSpectrum E.Carrier) → PrimeSpectrum (S p)) →
                      (∀ (p : PrimeSpectrum E.Carrier), PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap E.Carrier (S p)) (q p) = p) →
                        AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Cover (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.precoverage @AlgebraicGeometry.Etale)
                          T.left :=
fun {k} [Field k] T U E S [(p : PrimeSpectrum E.Carrier) → CommRing (S p)]
    [(p : PrimeSpectrum E.Carrier) → Algebra E.Carrier (S p)]
    [∀ (p : PrimeSpectrum E.Carrier), Algebra.Etale E.Carrier (S p)] hU q hq =>
  AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Cover.mkOfCovers (PrimeSpectrum E.Carrier)
    (fun p => AlgebraicGeometry.Spec (CommRingCat.of (S p)))
    (fun p =>
      CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (AlgebraicGeometry.Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap E.Carrier (S p))))
        (CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp
          (AlgebraicGeometry.Spec.map
            (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap (↑(T.left.presheaf.obj (Opposite.op ↑U))) E.Carrier)))
          (CategoryTheory.Over.Hom.left (AlgebraicGeometry.Over.fromSpecAffine T U))))

     8	/-!
     9	# The descent skeleton: finite tensor data descend to a finitely generated stage (RE-5, stage i)
    10	
    11	The pure-algebra half of RE-5 (worksheet §3.2 mechanism; rigid worksheet §2.4): over a
    12	field `k`, the tensor functor `− ⊗[k] M` commutes with the filtered union
    13	`B = ⋃ B₀` over finitely generated `k`-subalgebras, in the two forms the datum descent
    14	consumes:
    15	
    16	* **elements descend** — every element of `B ⊗[k] M` comes from `B₀ ⊗[k] M` for every
    17	  subalgebra `B₀` containing a finite set of tensor components
    18	  (`AlgebraicJacobian.Descent.exists_finset_forall_mem_range_rTensor`);
    19	* **equalities descend for free** — the stage inclusion `B₀ ⊗[k] M → B ⊗[k] M` is
    20	  *injective* (`rTensor_val_injective`; `M` is flat, `k` being a field), so any equality
    21	  of descended elements already holds at the stage.
    22	
    23	The geometric face, through the landed free base change
    24	`relSectionsBaseChange : R ⊗[k] Γ(C.left, V) ≃ₗ[R] Γ(C_R, V_R)`
    25	(`RelativeSectionsLinear.lean`):
    26	
    27	* `AlgebraicGeometry.relSectionsMap_relSectionsBaseChange` — the comparison square: the
    28	  sections comparison map `Γ(C_R, V_R) → Γ(C_{R'}, V_{R'})` corresponds under the
    29	  base-change equivalences to `rTensor` of the algebra map `R → R'`;
    30	* `AlgebraicGeometry.relSectionsMap_injective` — for an injective `R → R'` (e.g. a
    31	  subalgebra inclusion), the sections comparison map is injective on every qcqs open;
    32	* `AlgebraicGeometry.exists_finset_forall_mem_range_relSectionsMap` — every relative
    33	  section over `B` descends to `Γ(C_{B₀}, V_{B₀})` for every subalgebra `B₀` containing
    34	  a finite set of tensor components.
    35	
    36	The quantifier shape "`∃ s : Finset B, ∀ B₀ ⊇ s`" (rather than "`∃ B₀`") lets the datum
    37	descent (`DatumDescent.lean`) collect the finite sets of ALL its finitely many elements
    38	and adjoin them in one stage, with no directed-colimit bookkeeping.
    39	-/
    40	
    41	set_option autoImplicit false
    42	
    43	universe u
    44	
    45	open TensorProduct
    46	
    47	namespace AlgebraicJacobian
    48	
    49	namespace Descent
    50	
    51	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {B : Type u} [CommRing B] [Algebra k B]
    52	variable {M : Type u} [AddCommGroup M] [Module k M]
    53	
    54	/-- **Equalities descend for free** (stage-(i) skeleton, injectivity half): the stage
    55	inclusion `B₀ ⊗[k] M → B ⊗[k] M` induced by a `k`-subalgebra `B₀ ⊆ B` is injective —
    56	`M` is flat over the field `k`. Any equality between descended tensor data therefore
    57	already holds at the stage. -/
    58	theorem rTensor_val_injective (B₀ : Subalgebra k B) :
    59	    Function.Injective (LinearMap.rTensor M B₀.val.toLinearMap) :=
    60	  Module.Flat.rTensor_preserves_injective_linearMap
    61	    (M := M) B₀.val.toLinearMap Subtype.val_injective
    62	
    63	/-- **Elements descend** (stage-(i) skeleton, existence half): an element of `B ⊗[k] M`
    64	lies in the image of `B₀ ⊗[k] M` for every `k`-subalgebra `B₀` containing a suitable
    65	finite set of tensor components. Together with `Subalgebra.fg_adjoin_finset` this puts
    66	every finite family of tensors inside one finitely generated stage. -/
    67	theorem exists_finset_forall_mem_range_rTensor (x : B ⊗[k] M) :
    68	    ∃ s : Finset B, ∀ B₀ : Subalgebra k B, (s : Set B) ⊆ (B₀ : Set B) →
    69	      x ∈ LinearMap.range (LinearMap.rTensor M B₀.val.toLinearMap) := by
    70	  classical
    71	  obtain ⟨S, rfl⟩ := TensorProduct.exists_finset x
    72	  refine ⟨S.image Prod.fst, fun B₀ hs => ?_⟩
    73	  refine ⟨∑ p ∈ S.attach,
    74	    (⟨p.1.1, hs (Finset.mem_image_of_mem Prod.fst p.2)⟩ : B₀) ⊗ₜ[k] p.1.2, ?_⟩
    75	  rw [map_sum, ← Finset.sum_attach S fun p => p.1 ⊗ₜ[k] p.2]
    76	  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun p _ => rfl
    77	
    78	end Descent
    79	
    80	end AlgebraicJacobian

    82	namespace AlgebraicGeometry

    84	open CategoryTheory Limits MonoidalCategory CartesianMonoidalCategory Opposite
    85	open TopologicalSpace

    87	attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule Over.sectionsAlgebra
    88	
    89	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
    90	variable (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [Algebra k R]
    91	variable (R' : Type u) [CommRing R'] [Algebra k R'] [Algebra R R'] [IsScalarTower k R R']
    92	
    93	section Square
    94	
    95	variable {V : C.left.Opens}
    96	
    97	/-- **The comparison square** (stage-(i) bridge): the sections comparison map
    98	`relSectionsMap` over the test-ring change `R → R'` corresponds, under the free base
    99	change `relSectionsBaseChange`, to `rTensor` of the algebra map on the tensor factor. -/
   100	theorem relSectionsMap_relSectionsBaseChange
   101	    (hV : IsCompact (V : Set C.left)) (hV' : IsQuasiSeparated (V : Set C.left))
   102	    (x : R ⊗[k] Γ(C.left, V)) :
   103	    relSectionsMap C R R' V (relSectionsBaseChange C R hV hV' x) =
   104	      relSectionsBaseChange C R' hV hV'
   105	        (LinearMap.rTensor Γ(C.left, V)
   106	          (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k R R').toLinearMap x) := by
   107	  induction x with
   108	  | zero => simp only [map_zero]
   109	  | add x y hx hy => simp only [map_add, hx, hy]
   110	  | tmul a s =>
   111	    rw [relSectionsBaseChange_tmul, map_mul, relSectionsMap_overAlgebraMap,
   112	      relSectionsMap_pullback, LinearMap.rTensor_tmul, AlgHom.toLinearMap_apply,
   113	      IsScalarTower.coe_toAlgHom', relSectionsBaseChange_tmul]
   114	
   115	/-- **Equalities of relative sections descend for free**: over an injective test-ring
   116	change `R → R'` (e.g. a subalgebra inclusion `B₀ ⊆ B`), the sections comparison map is
   117	injective on every qcqs open. -/
   118	theorem relSectionsMap_injective (hinj : Function.Injective (algebraMap R R'))
   119	    (hV : IsCompact (V : Set C.left)) (hV' : IsQuasiSeparated (V : Set C.left)) :
   120	    Function.Injective (relSectionsMap C R R' V) := by
   121	  intro x y hxy
   122	  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := (relSectionsBaseChange C R hV hV').surjective x
   123	  obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := (relSectionsBaseChange C R hV hV').surjective y
   124	  rw [relSectionsMap_relSectionsBaseChange, relSectionsMap_relSectionsBaseChange] at hxy
   125	  refine congrArg _ (Module.Flat.rTensor_preserves_injective_linearMap
   126	    (M := Γ(C.left, V)) (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k R R').toLinearMap hinj ?_)
   127	  exact (relSectionsBaseChange C R' hV hV').injective hxy
   128	
   129	end Square
   130	
   131	section Descent
   132	
   133	variable {C}
   134	variable {B : Type u} [CommRing B] [Algebra k B]
   135	
   136	/-- **Relative sections descend to a finite stage**: a section of the relative curve
   137	`C_B` over a base-changed qcqs open `V_B` lies in the image of `Γ(C_{B₀}, V_{B₀})` for
   138	every `k`-subalgebra `B₀ ⊆ B` containing a suitable finite set of tensor components
   139	(one finite set per section; the datum descent adjoins the union). -/
   140	theorem exists_finset_forall_mem_range_relSectionsMap {V : C.left.Opens}
   141	    (hV : IsCompact (V : Set C.left)) (hV' : IsQuasiSeparated (V : Set C.left))
   142	    (x : Γ(relCurve C B, (fst C (overSpec k B)).left ⁻¹ᵁ V)) :
   143	    ∃ s : Finset B, ∀ B₀ : Subalgebra k B, (s : Set B) ⊆ (B₀ : Set B) →
   144	      ∃ x₀ : Γ(relCurve C ↥B₀, (fst C (overSpec k ↥B₀)).left ⁻¹ᵁ V),
   145	        relSectionsMap C ↥B₀ B V x₀ = x := by
   146	  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := AlgebraicJacobian.Descent.exists_finset_forall_mem_range_rTensor
   147	    (M := Γ(C.left, V)) ((relSectionsBaseChange C B hV hV').symm x)
   148	  refine ⟨s, fun B₀ hB₀ => ?_⟩
   149	  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := hs B₀ hB₀
   150	  refine ⟨relSectionsBaseChange C ↥B₀ hV hV' y, ?_⟩
   151	  rw [relSectionsMap_relSectionsBaseChange]
   152	  have hval : (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k ↥B₀ B).toLinearMap = B₀.val.toLinearMap := by
   153	    ext b; rfl
   154	  rw [hval, hy, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
   155	
   156	end Descent
   157	
   158	end AlgebraicGeometry

      "body": "[persistent] [persistent] REPRESENTABILITY PUSH, 2026-07-29 \u2014 the claim/lane protocol that makes 10 free-objective lanes not collide.\n\nWHY THIS EXISTS. This round replaces prescriptive per-leaf tasks with FIVE lanes per project: one REVIEWER and four PROVERS ranked p1..p4. The provers each pick their own target. That only works if claiming is explicit and public. This item is the claiming mechanism. Read it before your first edit.\n\nTHE FIVE LANES PER PROJECT\n- `review-ajc` / `review-ajcr` \u2014 reviewer. Read-mostly. Finds defects of ROUTE and ORGANISATION, not of individual proofs; may propose refactors and file tasks-as-proposals for the provers. Does not race provers for proof work.\n- `ajc-p1` / `ajcr-p1` \u2014 takes the MOST important open representability item.\n- `-p2`, `-p3`, `-p4` \u2014 2nd, 3rd, 4th most important, where \"important\" is measured against the project's representability headline, not by ease.\n\nCLAIMING \u2014 do this BEFORE you start proving, not after.\n 1. `horizon roadmap list --focus <your project's w4-rep / picrep subtree>` and read the reviewer's open notes.\n 2. Pick your item. Check no other lane owns it: an item with `--owner` set to another lane IS CLAIMED. Do not take it, even if you think you would be faster.\n 3. Claim it: `horizon roadmap set <id> --owner <your-task-id> --status active`. If your target is not yet a roadmap item, `roadmap add` it under the right parent first, then claim it.\n 4. Announce: one `horizon inbox add --kind info --to horizon --body \"CLAIM <lane>: <roadmap id> \u2014 <one line on what discharging it buys>\"`.\n 5. Release on exit: if you did NOT finish, `roadmap set <id> --owner ''` and leave a one-line inbox note saying where you stopped and what the next lane should NOT re-derive. An item left owned by a dead lane is worse than an unclaimed one.\n\nRANK IS A TIE-BREAK, NOT A FENCE. If p1's item turns out to be blocked on p3's, say so in the inbox and swap \u2014 rank exists so four lanes do not all converge on the same top item, not to stop you working on the right thing. p1 has first refusal on any contested item.\n\nYOU MAY PROPOSE WORK TO THE OTHER LANES. Direct-message with `horizon inbox add --kind hint --to task:<lane-id> --body \"\u2026\"`. A good proposal names the declaration, the file, and why it is worth more than what that lane currently holds. You may NOT reassign another lane's claimed item, and you may NOT create new horizon runs or tasks for teams outside your own (`horizon permissions` is false on both counts \u2014 propose to the human instead).\n\nSTANDING BINDING DECISIONS you must not relitigate: `I-0491` (AJC: no rational-point binder on the headline; `hasRationalPoint_of_curve` is FALSE and must be deleted, never proved) and `I-0492` (AJCR: `DivFamZar` widens to arbitrary affine opens; do NOT build the GL_2/Aut(P1) route). Read both.\n\nWHAT COUNTS AS PROGRESS, given the 2026-07-29 audit. That audit found 99 of 101 sampled representability claims refuted: 67 sorry-reachable, 17 VACUOUS, 12 hypothesis-shifted. So the bar is explicit:\n- A discharged obligation must be sorry-free AND its hypotheses must be inhabitable. Before you claim a gate closed, exhibit a witness for every antecedent, or say plainly which antecedent is still undischarged.\n- Do NOT add a class, structure field, or hypothesis whose statement does not mention the object it is supposedly about. `HasDivFunctor` is the cautionary case: its field asserted only that a presheaf category is nonempty, `C` did not occur, and it was advertised as the existence of the relative divisor functor. That is a vacuity, and it survived because nobody read the statement.\n- Do NOT discharge an obligation by projecting the hypothesis you assumed (`choose_spec.1` of your own binder). That is `P \u2192 P`.\n- A green `lake build` is not evidence a statement is non-vacuous. Check imports are current before believing a `lean_multi_attempt` success.\n\nCOMMIT DISCIPLINE. This is ONE shared ledger branch with 10 writers. Another lane's integrate sweep can commit your half-written file before you have measured it once. Write risky proofs as explicit `sorry` first, measure, then fill. Stage explicit files, never `add -A`.",

import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0AdmissibleAbelKernel
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0AdmissibleAbelEtaleSurjectiveTarget
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0ChartPlusFibreProducer
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0ChartPlusFibreTower

/-!
# Honest affine data for the admissible Abel chart

This module honestifies an affine degree-zero Picard class over one etale presentation,
presents its fixed admissible chart twist by a basic-open cocycle datum, and obtains an
H1-vanishing witness at every prime of the presentation carrier from unconditional Pic0
coverage.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3

universe u

open CategoryTheory Limits MonoidalCategory CartesianMonoidalCategory Opposite
open TopologicalSpace

namespace AlgebraicGeometry

open AlgebraicJacobian

attribute [local instance] Over.sectionsAlgebra Scheme.overModule Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra
attribute [local instance 10000] relCurve.instOver

variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
variable [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]

noncomputable section

set_option maxHeartbeats 1000000 in
-- The chosen chart unfolds the uniform coverage witnesses and their finiteness instances.
/-- The chart fixed inside the admissible Abel transformation covers every Pic0 class. -/
theorem chartLocus_admissibleAbelChart_eq_univ
    {T : Over (Spec (.of k))} (lam : pic0Subgroup C T) :
    chartLocus C (admissibleAbelChartIndex C)
      (admissibleAbelChartDivisor C) lam.1 = Set.univ := by
  classical
  letI : C.left.Over (Spec (.of k)) := .ofHom C.hom
  haveI : SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (C.left ↘ Spec (.of k)) :=
    inferInstanceAs (SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom)
  haveI : IsIntegral C.left := isIntegral_left_of_geometricallyReduced C
  haveI : LocallyOfFiniteType (C.left ↘ Spec (.of k)) :=
    inferInstanceAs (LocallyOfFiniteType C.hom)
  haveI : QuasiCompact (C.left ↘ Spec (.of k)) :=
    inferInstanceAs (QuasiCompact C.hom)
  haveI : Module.Finite k (Sheaf.HModule (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) 0) :=
    moduleFinite_hModule_zero C
  haveI : Module.Finite k (Sheaf.HModule (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) 1) :=
    moduleFinite_hModule_one C
  exact (exists_uniform_admissibleCoverageChart_eq_univ
    (C := C) (divRepAffP1Map_comp C) (genus C)
      (chi_moduleKSheaf C)).choose_spec.choose_spec.2 lam

/-- A datum witness at the scheme-theoretic test-point field descends across the canonical
residue-field isomorphism to the prime's algebraic residue field. -/
theorem BasicOpenCocycleDatum.hasWitnessH1Vanishing_residueField_of_testPointField
    {B : Type u} [CommRing B] [Algebra k B]
    {pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsFinite pi]
    (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B pi) (p : PrimeSpectrum B)
    (hp : D.HasWitnessH1Vanishing
      (Over.testPointField (T := overSpec k B) p)) :
    D.HasWitnessH1Vanishing p.asIdeal.ResidueField := by
  letI : Algebra p.asIdeal.ResidueField
      (Over.testPointField (T := overSpec k B) p) :=
    ((Scheme.Spec.residueFieldIso (.of B) p).inv).hom.toAlgebra
  haveI : IsScalarTower B p.asIdeal.ResidueField
      (Over.testPointField (T := overSpec k B) p) :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq'
      (algebraMap_testPointFieldAffine_factors p)
  exact (D.hasWitnessH1Vanishing_iff_of_fieldExtension
    p.asIdeal.ResidueField
      (Over.testPointField (T := overSpec k B) p)).mpr hp

set_option maxHeartbeats 1000000 in
-- Honestification and the full-locus chart elaborate a dependent datum presentation.
/-- An affine Pic0 class admits one etale presentation on whose carrier its admissible twist
is presented by a datum with an H1-vanishing witness at every prime. -/
theorem exists_admissibleAbelDatum_of_affine
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
    (lam : pic0Subgroup C (overSpec k A)) :
    ∃ (E : Algebra.EtaleCover A)
      (c : (relCurve C E.Carrier).CechPic)
      (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C E.Carrier (divRepAffP1Map C)),
      let g := Over.overSpecMap
        ((Algebra.ofId A E.Carrier).restrictScalars k)
      picEtMap C g lam.1 =
          relPicToPicEt C (overSpec k E.Carrier)
            (relPicMk C (overSpec k E.Carrier) c) ∧
        D.cechPicClass =
          c * Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C k E.Carrier)
            (chartTwistClass C (admissibleAbelChartIndex C)
              (admissibleAbelChartDivisor C)) ∧
        ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum E.Carrier,
          D.HasWitnessH1Vanishing p.asIdeal.ResidueField := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨E, x, hx⟩ : ∃ (E : Algebra.EtaleCover A) (x : descentClasses C E),
      picEtAffineEquiv C A lam.1 = PicEtAff.mk C E x := by
    induction picEtAffineEquiv C A lam.1 using PicEtAff.ind with
    | mk E x => exact ⟨E, x, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := relPicMk_surjective C (overSpec k E.Carrier)
    (x : relPic C (overSpec k E.Carrier))
  obtain ⟨D, hD⟩ :=
    exists_datum_cechPicClass_chartTwistClass
      (C := C) (π := divRepAffP1Map C) c
        (admissibleAbelChartIndex C) (admissibleAbelChartDivisor C)
  let g : overSpec k E.Carrier ⟶ overSpec k A :=
    Over.overSpecMap ((Algebra.ofId A E.Carrier).restrictScalars k)
  have hpic : picEtMap C g lam.1 =
      relPicToPicEt C (overSpec k E.Carrier)
        (relPicMk C (overSpec k E.Carrier) c) := by
    calc
      picEtMap C g lam.1 =
          relPicToPicEt C (overSpec k E.Carrier)
            (x : relPic C (overSpec k E.Carrier)) :=
        picEtMap_eq_relPicToPicEt_of_affineRepresentative
          C lam.1 E x hx
      _ = _ := by rw [hc]
  refine ⟨E, c, D, hpic, hD, ?_⟩
  intro p
  have htwist :=
    chartTwist_picEtMap_eq_relPicToPicEt_cechPicClass
      lam g c hpic D (admissibleAbelChartIndex C)
        (admissibleAbelChartDivisor C) hD
  have hplus :
      IsChartDatumPlusFibre C (divRepAffP1Map C)
        (relPicToPicEt C (overSpec k E.Carrier)
          (relPicMk C (overSpec k E.Carrier) D.cechPicClass)) D :=
    isChartDatumPlusFibre_of_relPicToPicEt C (divRepAffP1Map C)
      D.cechPicClass D rfl
  have hpres : IsChartDatumPresentation C (divRepAffP1Map C)
      (chartTwist C (admissibleAbelChartIndex C)
        (admissibleAbelChartDivisor C) (overSpec k E.Carrier)
          (picEtMap C g lam.1)) D := by
    rw [htwist]
    exact isChartDatumPresentation_of_plusFibre_tower
      C (divRepAffP1Map C) hplus
  have hmem : p ∈ chartLocus C (admissibleAbelChartIndex C)
      (admissibleAbelChartDivisor C) (pic0Map C g lam).1 := by
    rw [chartLocus_admissibleAbelChart_eq_univ]
    trivial
  have hpTest : D.HasWitnessH1Vanishing
      (Over.testPointField (T := overSpec k E.Carrier) p) :=
    (mem_chartLocus_iff_hasWitnessH1Vanishing hpres p).mp hmem
  exact D.hasWitnessH1Vanishing_residueField_of_testPointField p hpTest

end
